answers.rationale: The effective_rate relation establishes job J1 at 240 currency units per hour (TOW service code, per rate_card and service conditions).

Among seven tow_job records, only J6 has a blank billed_hours field. J1–J5 and J7 each carry a non-empty billed_hours value in WORLD-scoped tow_job; the blank_billed_hours purpose failure explicitly marks J6 as lacking an established billable quantity.

No relation in the harbor_towing World establishes a fuel surcharge for any job. job_charge for J3 is 240.0 on the basis of 2h at 120/hr with no surcharge component, and no fuel or surcharge relation exists.

J7 is a TOW at berth B12 starting at 20:00 (after 18:00). billing_outcome marks it insufficient_evidence because B12 after-hours towing lacks emergency documentation, and purpose_requirement_failure (berth_b12_after_hours) records that no emergency log is attached for J7.
